title: QueryLogEntry
description: One executed search. Lives in acquisition/query_log.jsonl (merged) and per-agent fragments acquisition/agents/*.queries.jsonl. Search is disposable but the log is the audit trail of what was tried.

query_id.description: Stable id; assigned at merge (q_<sha1[:10]>) if the agent did not set one

tool.description: Search tool used: web_search | web_extract | browser_exec | academic_api | other

search_angle.description: Slug of the planned angle this query served

notes.description: Dead ends, rate limits, hostile pages, query variants worth retrying
